heading: Write to us
intro: A question, a problem with your account, or something about your data: a person on our team reads every message and replies by email within one month, usually much sooner.
reportInstead: Reporting a story, comment or profile? Use the Report button next to it, so it reaches our moderators straight away. Reporting without an account, and how to reach us about legal matters, is on the

form.heading: Message

topics.question: A question
topics.data_request: My data (see, correct, download or delete it)

form.messageHint: Say what happened and what you’d like us to do. At most {{max}} characters.
form.messageTooLong: That’s too long. Keep it under 4,000 characters.
form.emailHint: We reply to this address and send you a reference.
form.signedInAs: We’ll reply to {{email}}, the address of your account @{{handle}}. Your username and user ID go with the message, so we can find your account; never your year of birth or age check.
form.aPersonReads: A person reads every message. We reply within one month.

sent.heading: Message sent
sent.body: Thanks. We’ve emailed you a receipt with your reference, {{reference}}. Keep it in case you write again about the same thing.

failures.invalid: Something in the message was refused. Check the fields and try again.
failures.unsent: We couldn’t send the message right now. Try again in a few minutes, or email us directly at {{supportEmail}}.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.
